newsitem.title: FRANCE: Third homeless death from cold in France.
newsitem.headline: Third homeless death from cold in France.

text.p: A 57-year-old homeless man and a 77-year-old retired man who lived alone in a camper were found dead of cold in the Paris area on Thursday, bringing to three the death toll in France from a two-day cold snap, police said.

Xavier Emmanuelli, secretary of state for emergency humanitarian action, said he had written to local officials across France urging them to make sure the homeless in their area were being adequately cared for during the cold weather.
The homeless man's body was found in a building under construction in Paris while the retired man was found dead in a garden near his camper in the Paris suburb of Orgeval.
On Christmas Day, a 53-year-old homeless woman died of cold in a disused railway depot in the Channel port of Le Treport.
Two male companions suffering from hypothermia were taken to hospital.

Rescue services said the three had refused prior offers from social workers to enter a shelter where they would have been fed and given a bed but would have had to abide by rules concerning curfews and drinking.
